blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ERC20F _update checks the restrictive registry; RECOVERY_ROLE can recover tokens from restricted accounts, PAUSER_ROLE can halt transfers, and the UUPS upgrader can change these rules. Pinned EVM-compatible reads identify registry 0x857efbfe934bc04e390675dbd5fd4ef7df5aa720 on all seven deployments. Finalized Solana slot 452748113 retains freeze authority and permanent delegate CBxsYp2sByWC5AgrEjze7Z8QTdDX56JJRgSEX7BUWady, with a pausable extension. No claim of permissionless immutable transfer is made.

oracleRisk.summary: FRNT is a fixed USD-par issuer claim. Native ERC20F issuance accepts a nominal quantity under MINTER_ROLE rather than computing NAV, collateral health or a borrower liquidation price. Reserve disclosure and the announced Chainlink PoR integration do not prove a live price-sensitive mint gate.

branchApplicability.rationale: Commission reserve/redemption rules establish fixed-par fiat redemption. The verified ERC20F mint function checks MINTER_ROLE and recipient access, without a price feed, collateral valuation, holder NAV or borrower liquidation engine. Trust asset valuation remains Backing evidence, not a holder conversion oracle.
